verdict.rationale: Luma documents image-to-video as a core mode with its own I2V pricing tier. Character references, keyframes (up to 16 per clip) and visual grounding support holding the subject and composition through generation. One hands-on community report notes morphing and weak temporal coherence in general generations, but it is not specific to image-to-video. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation that the input image's subject and composition are preserved, and independent hands-on corroboration of fidelity in image-to-video output.
